description: (needs account token) Sets how a site appears in search results and when a link is shared: site name, brand colour, search title and description, share title and description. Applies to the whole site, or to one domain when domain is set. Available once the site has its own domain. Does not charge.

domain.description: Optional: apply to this one domain of the site only.

serp_description.description: Optional: the description in search results.

serp_title.description: Optional: the title in search results.

share_description.description: Optional: the description when the link is shared.

share_title.description: Optional: the title when the link is shared.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: update_site_settings
title: Update site settings
